Covers the 120 named systems (Optro added 20 Nov 2026) on the Applications and technology tab; the 16 'Unknown application' placeholders are left out. Scores are judgements based on the evidence in the main tab, not measured data. Size (1-5): 5 = group-wide or all associates; 4 = a whole large operating company (e.g. Cytiva) or a major function across several operating companies; 3 = one function in an operating company, or several sites; 2 = one team, site or small user group; 1 = niche tool or retired. Complexity (1-5): 5 = core transactional system with many modules, heavy customisation, many interfaces and SOX or GxP validation; 4 = multi-module platform with many integrations or validated; 3 = configured SaaS with several integrations; 2 = standard SaaS, few integrations; 1 = point tool or add-on. Score = size + complexity; Rank uses RANK, so ties share a rank. Rows are sorted by score, then size. Area and Domain are looked up from the main tab by name. Change a score in columns E or F and the score and rank update; re-sort the tab to restore the order.
